bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
active="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)"
enabled="$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)"
test "$active" = active && test "$enabled" = enabled
result="$(cd "$root" && deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python scripts/userbot_test_client.py bot_start_menu)"
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -q USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=PASS
image="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
test "$image" = "sha256:9cc3afe33bf90e59dda71c2ca1fa8214a671e7af4aba90a1dc823dfc4310d6a3"
{ echo PROFILE_BUTTON_AFTER_DEPLOY_SMOKE; printf '%s\n' "$result"; echo USERBOT_ACTIVE_AFTER=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service); echo GAYBBS_ACTIVE=$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1); echo GAYBBS_IMAGE="$image"; } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
